title: Classify file roles, derivation, and search priority

state.decision_rationale: Deferred pending a corpus-derived role vocabulary and retrieval evidence. Incorrect generated or low-priority labels can hide authoritative evidence; derivation must come from explicit build or manifest provenance, not filename heuristics.

provenance.review_target: Reported 6.3 MB, 137715-line MKTCTX/3 packet; exact artifact not identified

feedback.verbatim: Add retrieval roles and derived-artifact relationships. The packet contains giant generated HTML files with embedded copies of results and corpora. That was occasionally hostile to search. Add role=source|test|fixture|generated|vendor|lockfile|documentation, derived_from=F..., and search_priority=normal|low|none. Tell a consumer that PAPER.html is a generated presentation of PAPER.md and search the Markdown by default.
feedback.normalized_claim: Annotate semantic file roles, derivation relationships, and default search priority so generated or duplicated presentations do not dominate retrieval.

current_behavior: Index records contain path, language, size, digest, projection, canonical alias, and projection reason.
Only byte-identical whole files are related through canonical aliases.
The generator does not infer source, test, fixture, generated, vendor, lockfile, or documentation roles.
No derivation or search-priority field exists.

proposal.summary: Evaluate explicit, provenance-bearing role and derivation metadata that retrieval consumers may use as hints without changing source fidelity.
candidate_changes: Define a small versioned role vocabulary with unknown or multiple-role behavior.
Represent derived_from relationships only when provided by build metadata, explicit manifests, or provable generation rules.
Add search_priority as a caller or generator hint rather than an instruction to discard content.
Allow explicit selection manifests to carry role, derivation, and priority metadata alongside paths.
Measure whether generated HTML and embedded payloads actually reduce search and reasoning accuracy.
non_goals: Do not infer derivation from similar filenames alone.
Do not let search_priority=none imply that a file is semantically irrelevant to every task.
Do not replace exact aliasing with lossy semantic deduplication.

questions: Are roles intrinsic file properties, selection-specific roles, or both?
Can one file be both generated and documentation, or test and fixture?
Who is authoritative for derived_from: build system, manifest author, analyzer, or heuristic?
Should retrieval hints live in core MKTCTX or an optional profile extension?
risks: Incorrect low-priority labels can hide the only authoritative representation.
A fixed role taxonomy may not fit domain-specific artifacts.
Heuristic derivation claims can create false provenance.
Extra metadata may increase packet size without helping models that ignore it.
evidence_needed: Corpus inventory of actual file roles and known generated-source relationships.
Retrieval benchmarks with generated HTML, embedded datasets, lockfiles, and source documents.
Manifest examples showing explicit role and derivation provenance.
Blind model tests for authoritative-source selection with and without hints.
